podcast.title: 19th Century Origins
podcast.body: When Portuguese explorers introduced the Spanish guitar to native Hawaiians in the 19th century, Hawaiians developed a unique playing style: laying the guitar horizontally on their laps and using a steel bar against the strings while plucking notes with the other hand. "When Portuguese explorers introduced the Spanish guitar to native Hawaiians in the 19th century, those Hawaiians developed a different playing style, laying the guitar horizontally on their laps while using a steel bar against the strings while plucking notes with the other."

podcast.title: Early 20th Century Craze
podcast.body: A craze for Hawaiian style music emerged in the US around 1898 and continued beyond World War II. "In the US and X to Y in 1898, there was a craze of Hawaiian style music that lasted beyond the Second World War."
